title: Archbishop Hoban vs. Glenville — Football (2026)
summary: Glenville defeated Archbishop Hoban 26–0 at Dowed Field on October 9, 2026. LaMarques Greenwood scored twice, Jaquan Gibson returned an interception 86 yards, and John Morris added a late 72-yard touchdown.
article_headline: Glenville Shuts Out Hoban 26–0 in Defensive Statement at Dowed Field
article_dek: Five turnovers and explosive scoring plays help the Tarblooders secure a major road win in Akron.
article_body:
AKRON, Ohio — Glenville faced Archbishop Hoban at Dowed Field on Friday, October 9, 2026, and returned home with a 26–0 shutout. Defensive takeaways and explosive plays separated the Tarblooders from the Knights in the Week 8 matchup.

Quarterback LaMarques Greenwood opened the scoring with a 1-yard touchdown run in the first quarter and added a 29-yard rushing score in the second. Defensive back Jaquan Gibson delivered an 86-yard interception return for a touchdown, sending Glenville into halftime ahead 19–0.

Glenville forced five turnovers and kept Hoban off the scoreboard. Gibson recorded two interceptions, while the Knights struggled to finish drives against the Tarblooders’ defense.

In the final minute, John Morris broke a 72-yard touchdown run to complete the scoring. A Kee On Sports Media Group game report credited Morris with 150 rushing yards.

Glenville improved to 6–2, while Hoban fell to 3–5 with its three-game winning streak snapped. This recap draws on published game reporting and statistics. Mason Bybee’s original sideline photographs will populate the gallery as they are uploaded.
